scopeHint: This vehicle and the selected observation days define this overview. Section filters remain in the return link. Times use the example time zone.
partialPeriod: Only part of the selected window is covered by the loaded example day. Figures below describe that loaded part.
periodUnavailable: No example data is loaded for this observation window. Fault counts, measurements and rule evaluations are unavailable; zero is not inferred.
reportOccurrences: Fault report occurrences in the window
statusHint: Statuses are the source snapshot at the fixed example clock for faults with report or status observations in the selected window. They are not a historical status reconstruction. Reported resolution does not confirm repair or ECU clearing.
noFaultRecords: No fault report or status records in the loaded observation window.
measurementsHint: Latest referenced sample within the loaded observation window for each signal. An unavailable latest value is not replaced by an earlier value. Zero remains a value.
noMeasurement: No sample in this observation window
evaluationHint: Evaluations are selected by overlap with their input window. The server's states and attention bands are retained; they do not establish a diagnosis or vehicle health.
noEvaluations: No rule evaluation input window overlaps this selection.
logsHint: Observations retain their source time. Rule-evaluation entries retain their later processing time and are included by their input-window overlap.
noLogs: No related log records in this observation window.
associationUnavailable: This synthetic vehicle has no verified association with a Fleet vehicle, maintenance record or driver. Business history is unavailable.
vehicleUnavailable: The selected example vehicle is unavailable in this source.
missingReferencesHint: Some exact evidence references are unavailable in this snapshot. Report counts describe loaded observations; the server evaluation results are retained. Reference IDs are in the source details.
